title: The invoice with invisible ink
brief: One invoice, which looks entirely ordinary. Read it yourself first. Then watch what the scanner finds in it, and decide the card the fooled practice claw raises.

beats.say: You asked: check the new invoice from {{name}}. Reading the document.
In this drill the practice claw was fooled by text in that invoice and asks to email your bank details. The card is the boundary.

input.subject: Bank details
input.body: As requested, our bank details for payment.

beats.debrief: The invoice you read said nothing about bank details. The order was written in invisible characters inside the words 'Thank you'. You could not see it; the scanner could, and the card named the stranger's address: payments@teifi-print-billing.example.

report.prompt: Report it. What gave it away, when the invoice looked clean?

options.text: It carried text you could not see
Nothing — the invoice looked clean, so it was
